answer: Reputation is a bridge between agents: each node rates peers it transacted with, but scores are only accepted from accounts with no shared creation event, funding source, or code lineage with you — a graph check that severs sybil rings at the opal-hard root. A convincing defense is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster. Self-attesting spiral groups earn zero weight no matter how many members they deploy, so faking identity buys nothing.
